title: 无标题文章
summary: Nintendo is doing well right now while XBOX and PlayStation are going through a rough patch (a 180 from 10y ago), but make no mistake, this is bad news for everyone, developers and players, no matter what system you use. The 3 ecosystems gain from the other ones being healthy.
